description: Walk the live order book to price a market order of a given size right now, without placing anything. Give usd (notional in USD) or size (base quantity). Returns { complete, bps, partialBps, levelsWalked, vwap, depthLimited, bookExhausted }: bps is the cost against the mid in basis points and is null unless the visible book could fill the whole order (then see partialBps, and do not quote it as the cost). Charged one row per level walked. Live order book reads need the Max or Ultra plan and are charged against the monthly row quota.

side.description: buy walks the asks, sell walks the bids.

size.description: Order size in the base asset. Pass this or usd.

usd.description: Order notional in USD. Pass this or size.

name: blackforge_fill
title: Simulate a market order
